templates.name: Đơn thuốc

source.supplement: Missing keys/synthetic print identity supplied by project convention

templates.linePolicy: Source immutable version/snapshot; correction/reprint never changes previous issued document; mark synthetic outputs prominently
templates.numberPolicy: Server-issued per facility+documentType+year, atomic sequence/unique constraint; do not derive from array position
templates.signatureNullPolicy: Wet-signature output may have signedAt/signatureReference both null until signed. Payer signerUuid may be null; never create Patient/Provider for signature only. Clinical signer UUID required.

dailyReports.dateInterval: local start-of-day inclusive, next local day exclusive

visits.opened: count distinct visitUuid by startAt local date
visits.completed: count by completedAt local date with status=completed; cancellations/left separated; never count encounters as visits

revenue.gross: sum settled successful receipt amounts by settledAt, not bill totals
revenue.refund: sum settled refunds by refund settledAt day, even if original receipt was earlier

dailyReports.privacy: Aggregate only; no patient/provider personal identities in manager output
